title: Prospective study: analysis of duplex sonographic changes after volume loading of renal patients and analysis of proteomic and histopathologic changes in renal venous congestion
summary:
Prospektive Erfassung der Auswirkung von Volumenbelastung nierenkranker Patienten auf duplexsonographische Parameter der renalen Kongestion.  Prospektive Erfassung klinischer, laborchemischer, duplexsonographischer, proteomischer und histopathologischer Parameter zur Charakterisierung der renalen Kongestion. 
Analyse von Parametern der renalen Kongestion in einer Kohorte 
nierenkranker Patienten.

interventions.name: Analysis of duplex sonographic changes before volume loading of renal patients with indication for renal biopsy
Analysis of duplex sonographic changes after volume loading of renal patients with indication for renal biopsy

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Kidney disease with indication for kidney biopsy
-voluntary participation, ability to give informed consent
-Signed informed consent for this study
-Legal age
Exclusion criteria:
- Refusal of the examination/participation in the study
- Lack of possibility to cooperate with the sonography 
- Underage 
- Pregnancy or breastfeeding 
- Patients after kidney transplantation (NTX) 
- Circumstances that do not allow Doppler sonography to be performed or interpreted 
(e.g. severe dys-/tachypnea)
